Title: Log Analytics New Query Experience - Example Queries

Body.Content:
Example queries are a great way to start your Log Analytics experience. Pre-built queries that provide an instant insight into a resource or an issue shorten the time it takes to start using Log Analytics and provide a nice way to start learning and using KQL.  We have been hard at work collecting and curating over 250 example queries, designed to provide instant value.

We are also announcing a new sidebar query experience.  All the functionality of the dialog may be accessed from the queries pane on the left-hand side of Log Analytics.  You can also hover over a query name to get the query description and additional functionality.

Finally, the query explorer experience for saving and sharing user generated queries will remain unchanged, for the time being. As we evolve our queries experience, we will add abilities to save and share queries in the new experience allowing users to achieve more with Log Analytics.

To learn more about these new updates and to see examples, please read our documentation.
